Use this as the visual direction, not as a source of factual business statistics.</em></p><h1>1. Project Overview</h1><p>Build a modern, responsive corporate website for Visha IT Solutions. The website must present the company as a professional technology and talent solutions business and generate enquiries for four core services: E-Commerce, Digital Marketing, Recruitment, and Training.</p><h1>2. Primary Website Goals</h1><ul><li>Build trust and a professional online presence.</li><li>Generate project enquiries and quote requests.</li><li>Generate recruitment/hiring enquiries.</li><li>Promote training programs and collect candidate enquiries.</li><li>Clearly explain the four core services.</li><li>Provide easy contact through form, email, phone and WhatsApp if supplied.</li><li>Be fast, mobile-friendly, SEO-ready and easy to maintain.</li></ul><h1>3. Target Users</h1><ul><li>Business owners and companies looking for e-commerce or digital marketing services.</li><li>Companies requiring recruitment or staffing support.</li><li>Students and job seekers interested in training programs.</li><li>Existing clients looking for support or additional services.</li></ul><h1>4. Header / Navigation</h1><p>Desktop header:</p><ul><li>Top information bar: official email, phone and permitted business/virtual-office address.</li><li>Logo: Visha IT Solutions.</li><li>Navigation: Home, About Us, Services, Training, Careers, Contact Us.</li><li>Primary CTA button: Get a Project Quote.</li><li>Sticky header on scroll.</li></ul><p>Mobile:</p><ul><li>Hamburger menu.</li><li>Logo visible.</li><li>Get a Project Quote CTA accessible from menu.</li><li>Tap-to-call and tap-to-email actions.</li></ul><h1>6. Get a Project Quote Form</h1><p>The primary lead-generation form should contain:</p><ul><li>Full Name – required</li><li>Company Name – optional/required as decided</li><li>Business Email – required</li><li>Phone Number – required</li><li>Service Required – dropdown: E-Commerce, Digital Marketing, Recruitment, Training, Other</li><li>Project/Requirement Description – required</li><li>Budget Range – optional</li><li>Preferred Contact Method – Email / Phone / WhatsApp</li><li>Consent checkbox for privacy policy.</li><li>Submit button: Get a Free Project Quote.</li></ul><p>After submission:</p><ul><li>Validate required fields and email/phone format.</li><li>Show success message: Thank you. Our team will contact you shortly.</li><li>Send notification to the official company email.</li><li>Store enquiry in admin/database if backend is implemented.</li><li>Prevent spam using CAPTCHA or equivalent protection.</li><li>Do not expose submitted data publicly.</li></ul><h1>10. Careers</h1><ul><li>List current openings.</li><li>Job title, location, experience, employment type and short description.</li><li>Apply Now button.</li><li>Resume upload form.</li><li>Candidate acknowledgement email.</li><li>Admin notification for each application.</li></ul><h1>12. Projects / Portfolio</h1><ul><li>Show only genuine completed projects or clearly label demo/internal projects.</li><li>Project cards: title, category, technologies, short description and outcome.</li><li>Optional project detail page.</li><li>Do not publish client logos, names, screenshots or results without permission.</li></ul><h1>13. Admin / Content Management</h1><p>Preferred: CMS or simple admin panel so the business team can update:</p><ul><li>Services.</li><li>Training programs.</li><li>Career openings.</li><li>Projects/portfolio.</li><li>Contact information.</li><li>Homepage text.</li><li>Blog/news if added later.</li></ul><h1>14. Technical Requirements</h1><ul><li>Responsive design for desktop, tablet and mobile.</li><li>Modern semantic HTML5/CSS3/JavaScript.</li><li>Developer may use React/Next.js or another agreed framework; choose based on maintainability and hosting requirements.</li><li>Backend/API required for forms, resume uploads and admin functions.</li><li>HTTPS/SSL mandatory.</li><li>Secure server-side validation.</li><li>Rate limiting/spam protection for public forms.</li><li>Secure file upload restrictions for resumes.</li><li>Database backups if a database is used.</li><li>No hard-coded secrets or API keys in frontend code.</li></ul><h1>15. SEO Requirements</h1><ul><li>Unique title and meta description for every page.</li><li>Clean URLs.</li><li>H1/H2 heading structure.</li><li>Open Graph/social sharing metadata.</li><li>XML sitemap.</li><li>Robots.txt.</li><li>Canonical URLs.</li><li>Local SEO for Hyderabad where appropriate.</li><li>Google Search Console and Analytics setup after ownership/access is provided.</li><li>Fast-loading optimized images with alt text.</li></ul><h1>16. Design Requirements</h1><ul><li>Overall style: modern, clean, corporate and trustworthy.</li><li>Primary visual direction: blue/white with dark navy accents.</li><li>Rounded cards, clean icons and generous spacing.</li><li>Use the supplied reference screenshot as the visual direction.</li><li>Use the official Visha IT Solutions logo and brand assets once supplied.</li><li>Typography must be readable and consistent.</li><li>Animations should be subtle and not reduce performance.</li><li>Accessibility: keyboard navigation, visible focus states, sufficient contrast, alt text and accessible form labels.</li></ul><h1>17. Content &amp; Business Rules</h1><ul><li>Do not invent clients, projects, reviews, employee counts, placement counts or revenue figures.</li><li>All claims such as '100+ clients' or '250+ projects' require written business approval before publishing.</li><li>Use the final official domain/email after domain registration.</li><li>Use the exact virtual-office address allowed by the NestVault agreement.</li><li>Privacy Policy and Terms must be reviewed/approved before launch.</li></ul><h1>18.
